item.title: Online Store / Mog Station Maintenance (Feb. 1)
The Unending Journey – Live Stream Adventures with the Community Team
item.description: All aboard The Unending Journey's next episode on Wednesday, February 4! Join the EU Community team as we tap in for some brand-new challenges. For this episode, we'll first stop the Doomtrain in its tracks and then travel to the Arcadion as we enter the ring once more. Make sure to mind the gap(s) before facing the Heavyweight contestants! Put on your best glamour and join us for some screenshots at the Solution Nine Aetheryte Plaza on Ragnarok (Chaos DC)!

item.title: THE PRIMALS Dark Decades Tour BUDOKAN Blu-ray Available for Pre-order!
item.description: We are pleased to announce the upcoming release of THE PRIMALS Dark Decades Tour BUDOKAN on Blu-ray! Last year, this monumental show delivered everything from classic tracks to fan-favorites from Dawntrail, the latest major expansion, all in THE PRIMALS' hard-rock style. Relive the performance from Monday, September 29, 2025, complete with a special guest appearance and 19 unforgettable songs! But wait─there's more! Bonus content includes behind-the-scenes footage of the Zepp tour culminating in the Nippon Budokan finale, and the music video for "Not Afraid." Get ready to rock, Warriors of Light—reserve your copy today!

item.title: This Cake's Rollin' in Berries!
item.description:
Greetings and salutations, Warriors of Light! It's Okieeomi from the Community team!
This winter has been a cold one with multiple major snowstorms stampeding throughout the world. We hope you're all staying warm and cozy this winter. And if you're not--on the horizon is a seasonal event to warm your heart...

item.title: Announcing the Crystalline Conflict Regional Championship 2026 North America Qualifiers!
item.description: We are excited to announce the contenders stepping up to face off in the North American Qualifiers! In this first round, teams will be competing over eight spots to move on to the Quarterfinals. Team leaders will be contacted via in-game mail, so be sure to check the Moogle Delivery for further instructions! Visit the Crystalline Conflict Regional Championship 2026 website.

Play Free for up to 4 Days in the Latest Free Login Campaign!
item.description: In the hope that would-be adventurers can experience all that FFXIV has to offer, we are pleased to announce the latest Free Login Campaign! Dare to travel Into the Mist? Patch 7.4 will have you facing the latest challenges on offer, be it unforgettable duties like Hell on Rails, or the Heavyweight Division of the Arcadion raid dungeon. What's more, the new glamour system update has unlocked fashion possibilities that transcend level, job, and class, allowing you to customize your character like never before. And don't forget to check out the new Strategy Board feature that provides the ideal tools to map out battle tactics and streamline communication with your party members.

New Year's Greetings!
item.description: Happy new year to all you FFXIVers out there! This is Producer & Director Naoki Yoshida. We ended last year with the release of Patch 7.4 on December 16, and I hope Warriors of Light the world over are enjoying a memorable holiday season both at home and in Eorzea. The Development team has already finished preparations for the release of the savage tier raid, along with a number of other updates, so I'm pleased to say they're all taking a hard-earned rest. That said, it won't be long before April is here, and with it the next Fan Festival. There will be plenty to share about what's next for FFXIV, so it'll be full steam ahead when we return to the office! This year marks thirteen years since the release of A Realm Reborn. The state of the world and the way we live in it have changed considerably in that time, even if we tend not to notice the gradual shifts that shape our lives day by day. Even having worked primarily with FFXIV throughout these years, I can't help but feel the weight of those changes as I pause to reflect. FFXIV has already taken its first step on a new ten-year journey, and this year will mark an especially significant second step. As I said, the world is changing, and FFXIV must be ready to change alongside it—reflecting the demands of an evolving market, as well as the ways you live and play. Drawing on everything we've learned, we are fully committed to delivering new experiences and fresh surprises in the years ahead. I hope you're looking forward to the next update, as well as everything we have planned for the upcoming Fan Festivals! ...And just as I was contemplating my keynote speech, what should I find but this note slid under my office door.

item.title: Announcing the Crystalline Conflict Regional Championship 2026!
item.description: We are pleased to announce the Crystalline Conflict Regional Championship 2026, a series of official FINAL FANTASY XIV PvP tournaments being held in each region to determine the ultimate victor of Crystalline Conflict in North America, Europe & Oceania, and Japan. The tournament will begin with Preliminaries and Quarterfinals, which will be held online. Teams that emerge victorious in the Quarterfinals will be invited to their local Fan Festival to take part in the Finals to decide the regional champion!

item.title: Lali-ho, we went to Anime Expo!
item.description:
Hello, everyone!  
It's Ali from the FFXIV Marketing team back with another event recap! We had an amazing opportunity to come to Anime Expo this year and celebrate with Yoshi-P who was invited as a Guest of Honor! I'm also thrilled to be joined by Minaryne from the Community team who has a lovely recap of the Cosplay Gathering at Anime Expo and our Downtown Los Angeles Gathering!

item.title: Unleashed
item.description:
Voltenyne here, with the final round of lyrics from the Cruiserweight Tier!
We've finally arrived at the theme of Howling Blade! It's hard to focus on the song when you're evading his dashes and beams, so let's disengage from the fight and lock in on those lyrics!

item.title: Not Afraid
item.description:

Time for us to go balls-to-the-wall and smash through the floor with Brute Abominator's theme! His rage has grown out of control and won't stop until he's blown away the competition!
